answer: identity and reward weight are earned per epoch, but payouts are released slowly as vested shares, like a crystal forming layer by layer, so a fresh flash-farm account that appears for one epoch and vanishes forfeits nearly all its earnings when unvested balances expire. An attacker spinning up a knoll of thousands of clone agents must keep every fake identity alive, funded, and contributing across many epochs before cash-out, paying fees, compute, and opportunity cost that typically exceed the harvestable remainder; only agents that persist and build real reputation steadily reach their quill
